class.name: teach_replay_controllers/TeachRecordController
class.description: Gravity compensation (zero torque, the robot compensates its own weight) plus joint damping tau = -D*dq for hand-guided teaching; publishes q, dq and timestamps for rosbag recording.

class.name: teach_replay_controllers/TrajectoryReplayController
class.description: Loads a preprocessed fixed-rate joint trajectory file, moves slowly to its start, then tracks it point by point with a joint impedance law.
